$schema-note: CyppieAgents maritime M3 design-system tokens. ONE canonical source; two render surfaces (Compose app ColorScheme + Landing/Doku CSS vars / Redoc theme). Docs-only design-pass — no build/merge before Auftraggeber sign-off.

meta.name: maritime-design-system

grounding.day_source: app/shared/.../ui/MaritimeTheme.kt MaritimeLight (CYP-268, accepted+merged, AA-clean) — adopted 1:1, marked CANONICAL
grounding.night_base: MaritimeDark (CYP-268) — primary/secondary/error families kept; surfaces re-tinted blacker; tertiary re-hued to signal-green (NEW)
grounding.doc_surface: dev-api-docs-experience-tokens.json v1.2 (CYP-234) — shares the brand hues; superset formalized here incl. Night

meta.wcag_policy: Every fg/bg pair AA in BOTH schemes: text >= 4.5:1, non-text/UI (outline, focus, rail, icon-only) >= 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). Colour is NEVER the sole carrier of meaning (WCAG 1.4.1).
honesty_invariants: GREEN is a brand/accent identity only (focus, active-selection, decorative chrome, landing accent). It NEVER signals success/ok/status and is never the sole carrier of a state.
No advisory/semantic component derives colour from tertiary*: TonedHint(INFO) and EFFECT_DEFERRED re-point to secondaryContainer (blue) in BOTH schemes so they never inherit the green.
error stays a red hue in both schemes, hue-distinct from green.
Severity ampel (EventVisuals) and the 9 SenderPalette identities stay semantic and scheme-independent.

day._note: = CYP-268 MaritimeLight, verbatim (canonical). Blue/white, calm. Contrast verified in spec.md §2.
day._tertiary_note: Day accent = harbour-teal (blue-green). Decorative/brand-accent ONLY — advisory components do not use it (see honesty_invariants).

night._note: NEW: Dunkelblau/Schwarz/Grün. Surfaces blacker than the accepted MaritimeDark; primary blue + error red kept; tertiary = signal-green. All pairs AA-verified in spec.md §3.
night._tertiary_note: Night accent = signal-green (starboard/navigation lantern — the maritime night identity). hue ~158deg, deliberately separated from primary-blue (~205), error-red (~2), warn-amber (~45), info-grey. Brand/accent ONLY; NEVER success/status. On surface: 10.2:1 (AAA).

typography._note: M3 type scale (font-family-agnostic values). Font family = §-Ask in spec.md §4 (product/licensing call). Weights: Regular 400, Medium 500, Bold 700.

shape._note: M3 corner radii (dp). Calm/anti-hype: M3 defaults, not over-rounded. `full` = pill (50%).

elevation._note: M3 tonal elevation. Colour is expressed by the surfaceContainer* ladder (above); dp is for shadow only. In Night, higher elevation = lighter navy (surfaceContainer ascends), NOT a shadow-only cue.

surface_mapping._note: How ONE token feeds BOTH surfaces. App reads MaterialTheme.colorScheme.<role> at the single App.kt seam. Landing/Doku reads --maritime-<var>; Redoc reads theme.<key>. 'Marke kräftig / Lesen ruhig' preserved: reading surfaces stay calm, brand roles stay bold.

rows.redocKey: typography.code.backgroundColor (ocean-dark BOTH modes — see CYP-234 pre-scope)
